description: Read a SMALL file from the sandbox (absolute `path`, max 5 MB) into this conversation: `content` as UTF-8 text by default, `as_text: false` → `content_base64`. For build artifacts, archives, binaries or anything big use `get_download_url` instead — you get a short-lived link and download it with curl, without pulling base64 into your context. Requires: token + live sandbox_id. Max 5 MB — bigger: get_download_url.

sandbox_id.description: Sandbox id as returned by create_sandbox / list_sandboxes, e.g. "sb_3f2a…".

name: download_file
title: Download a file from a sandbox
